stories.title: ‘Die on the road, not in hospital’: Chinese man takes paralysed wife on epic road trip
stories.summary: A man from eastern China has spent a decade travelling with his partially paralysed wife, claiming that life on the road has made her “100 times” more spirited. stories.headline: Philippines’ Marcos slammed over $3b family estate tax, says ‘very busy’ with government

opening: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jnr has put his anti-corruption drive at the centre of his presidency, but questions over his late father’s estate taxes and the family’s past ill-gotten wealth have prompted critics to question his commitment.

Last month, Marcos pledged in his address to Congress to continue fighting alleged irregularities in flood-control projects, stressing that the campaign would be a test of whether his administration could hold even powerful allies to account.
